## NeuroSphere SLO planning targets
All targets are planning targets, to be measured. See docs/ops/slo.md.

content.title: API request duration p95 (target to be measured)
content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'ns.api.request.duration' | summarize p95 = percentile(value, 95) by bin(timestamp, 5m)

content.title: API errors (availability target 99.9%, to be measured)
content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'ns.api.request.errors' | summarize errors = sum(value) by bin(timestamp, 5m)

content.title: Dashboard query duration p95 (<= 2 s target, to be measured)
content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'ns.dashboard.query.duration' | summarize p95 = percentile(value, 95) by bin(timestamp, 5m)

content.title: Catalog query duration p95 (<= 500 ms target, to be measured)
content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'ns.catalog.query.duration' | summarize p95 = percentile(value, 95) by bin(timestamp, 5m)

content.title: Map freshness lag p95 (<= 10 s target, to be measured)
content.query: customMetrics | where name == 'ns.map.freshness.lag' | summarize p95 = percentile(value, 95) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
